LAP Solving

Core functions for solving linear assignment problems

lap_solve()
Solve Linear Assignment Problems with a Tidy Interface
lap_solve_batch() print(<lap_solve_batch_result>) summary(<lap_solve_batch_result>) is_lap_solve_batch_result()
Solve Many Assignment Problems
lap_solve_kbest() print(<lap_solve_kbest_result>) summary(<lap_solve_kbest_result>) is_lap_solve_kbest_result()
Find the k Best Assignments
lap_solve_line_metric() summary(<lap_line_metric_result>)
Solve a One-Dimensional Assignment Problem
lap_solvers() register_lap_solver()
Assignment Solvers

Solve a Linear Assignment Problem

Solve an Assignment Problem and Return Dual Potentials
bottleneck_assignment() summary(<bottleneck_result>)
Solve the Bottleneck Assignment Problem
sinkhorn() print(<sinkhorn_result>) summary(<sinkhorn_result>) as.matrix(<sinkhorn_result>)
Entropic Optimal Transport by Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration
sinkhorn_to_assignment()
Round a Sinkhorn Transport Plan to an Assignment
